newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to softer, action limited.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to softer, action limited.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to softer on Tuesday.
Gasoline was weaker with futures and newspaper speculation that the British budget may be delayed for two or three weeks.
Naphtha was steady. The influence of weaker futures was balanced by news of fresh refinery run cuts at Shell's 350,000 barrels per day Pernis refinery and an increase in demand for N+A material.

Demand for heating oil continued limited with barges talked steady at June IPE gas oil +$1-$1.50 a tonne. Good availability of Russian grade cargoes against limited buying interest suggested the grade would lose some of its current June +$1.50-$2.50 premium.

High sulphur fuel barges were lower on aggressive selling at $78 a tonne by one player who said he was emptying his tanks to make way for Russian material. Markets in other fuel grades were quiet and steady.
